modules.title: Selection of foundation and Sub-soil exploration/investigation
topics: Types of foundation, Factors affecting the selection of type of foundations, Steps in choosing types of foundation based on soil condition
Objectives and planning of exploration program, methods of exploration-wash boring and rotary drilling-depth of boring
Soil samples and soil samplers-representative and undisturbed sampling
Field penetration tests: SPT, SCPT, DCPT; Introduction to geophysical methods, Bore log, report writing

modules.title: Shallow Foundation
topics: Introduction, significant depth, design criteria, modes of shear failures
Detail study of bearing capacity theories (Prandtl, Rankine, Terzaghi, Skempton, Meyerhof), Bearing capacity determination using IS Code
Settlement, components of settlement & its estimation, permissible settlement, Proportioning of footing for equal settlement, allowable bearing pressure
Bearing capacity from in-situ tests (SPT, SCPT, PLATE LOAD), Factors affecting bearing capacity
Contact pressure under rigid and flexible footings; Floating foundation

modules.title: Pile foundations
topics: Introduction, Load transfer mechanism, Types of piles and their function
Factors influencing selection of pile, their method of installation and their load carrying characteristics for cohesive and granular soils
Piles subjected to vertical loads- pile load carrying capacity from static formula, dynamic formulae (ENR and Hiley), Pile load test
Pile group: carrying capacity, efficiency and settlement; Negative skin friction

modules.title: Foundations on problematic soil & Introduction to Geosynthetics
topics: Significant characteristics of expansive and collapsible soils, footing on such soils, Problems and preventive measures
Under-reamed pile foundation-its concept, design & field installation
Introduction to geosynthetics-materials, types, functions and uses

modules.title: Lateral Earth Pressure and Retaining Walls
topics: Active, Passive and Earth pressure at rest; Rankine's theory of earth pressure, Earth pressures in layered soils
Coulomb's earth pressure theory, Culmann's graphical method
Types of retaining walls- stability of retaining walls against overturning, sliding, bearing capacity and drainage from backfill
Reinforced earth retaining walls
